CLIPLoader.name: CLIPLoader
CLIPLoader.description:
Recipes:
sd: clip-l
stable cascade: clip-g
sd3: t5 xxl / clip-g / clip-l
stable audio: t5 base
mochi: t5 xxl
cogvideox: t5 xxl (226-token padding)
cosmos: old t5 xxl
lumina2: gemma 2 2B
wan: umt5 xxl
hidream: llama-3.1 (Recommend) or t5
omnigen2: qwen vl 2.5 3B
joyimage: qwen3-vl 8B
lens: gpt-oss-20b
pixeldit: gemma 2 2B elm
minimax: MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL or Music3 Qwen/RVQ

clip.tooltip: The CLIP model used for encoding the text.

CLIPTextEncode.name: CLIPTextEncode
CLIPTextEncode.description: Encodes a text prompt using a CLIP model into an embedding that can be used to guide the diffusion model towards generating specific images.
output_tooltips: A conditioning containing the embedded text used to guide the diffusion model.

images.tooltip: The images to create a video from.

audio.tooltip: The audio to add to the video.

bit_depth.tooltip: Auto uses 8-bit for sRGB and 10-bit for HDR. Explicit 8-bit and 10-bit choices are independent of colorspace.

color_space.tooltip: Colorspace of the input images. HDR selects BT.2020/HLG and HDR PQ selects BT.2020/PQ.

codec.tooltip: Optionally encode the video immediately. None keeps the images in tensor form; Auto uses H.264.

GetImageSize.name: GetImageSize
GetImageSize.description: Returns the width, height, and batch size of the image.

image.tooltip: Image or video to condition the latent video on. Must be 8*n + 1 frames. If the video is not 8*n + 1 frames, it will be cropped to the nearest 8*n + 1 frames.

frame_idx.tooltip: Frame index to start the conditioning at. For single-frame images or videos with 1-8 frames, any frame_idx value is acceptable. For videos with 9+ frames, frame_idx must be divisible by 8, otherwise it will be rounded down to the nearest multiple of 8. Negative values are counted from the end of the video.

attention_mask.tooltip: Optional pixel-space spatial mask. Controls per-region conditioning influence via self-attention, multiplied by strength.

iclora_parameters.tooltip: Optional IC-LoRA parameters from a Get IC-LoRA Parameters node. Used for adjusting guide processing as required by certain IC-LoRAs (eg. those with a reference_downscale_factor > 1). When chained, each LTXVAddGuide uses only the parameters connected to it.

audio_vae.tooltip: The Audio VAE model used for decoding the latent.

LTXVConcatAVLatent.name: LTXVConcatAVLatent
LTXVConcatAVLatent.description: Merge a video latent and an audio latent into a joint AV latent (any AV model, e.g. LTXV or MiniMax H3).

LTXVDualCFGGuider.name: LTXVDualCFGGuider
LTXVDualCFGGuider.description: Separate CFG scales for the video and audio modalities of a packed LTXV-AV latent.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent audio samples in the batch.

audio_vae.tooltip: The Audio VAE model to get configuration from.

img_compression.tooltip: Amount of compression to apply on image.

LTXVSeparateAVLatent.name: LTXVSeparateAVLatent
LTXVSeparateAVLatent.description: Split a joint AV latent into its video and audio latents (any AV model, e.g. LTXV or MiniMax H3).

LoraLoaderModelOnly.name: LoraLoaderModelOnly
LoraLoaderModelOnly.description: This LoRAs loader is used to modify the diffusion model, altering the way in which latents are denoised such as applying styles. Multiple LoRA nodes can be linked together.

PreviewAny.name: PreviewAny
PreviewAny.description: Preview any input value as text.

resize_type.tooltip: Select how to resize: by exact dimensions, scale factor, matching another image, etc.

width.tooltip: Target width in pixels. Set to 0 to auto-calculate from height while preserving aspect ratio.

height.tooltip: Target height in pixels. Set to 0 to auto-calculate from width while preserving aspect ratio.

crop.tooltip: How to handle aspect ratio mismatch: 'disabled' stretches to fit, 'center' crops to maintain aspect ratio.

multiplier.tooltip: Scale factor (e.g., 2.0 doubles size, 0.5 halves size).

longer_size.tooltip: The longer edge will be resized to this value. Aspect ratio is preserved.

shorter_size.tooltip: The shorter edge will be resized to this value. Aspect ratio is preserved.

width.tooltip: Target width in pixels. Height auto-adjusts to preserve aspect ratio.

height.tooltip: Target height in pixels. Width auto-adjusts to preserve aspect ratio.

megapixels.tooltip: Target total megapixels (e.g., 1.0 ≈ 1024×1024). Aspect ratio is preserved.

match.tooltip: Resize input to match the dimensions of this reference image or mask.

crop.tooltip: How to handle aspect ratio mismatch: 'disabled' stretches to fit, 'center' crops to maintain aspect ratio.

multiple.tooltip: Resize so width and height are divisible by this number. Useful for latent alignment (e.g., 8 or 64).

scale_method.tooltip: Interpolation algorithm. 'area' is best for downscaling, 'lanczos' for upscaling, 'nearest-exact' for pixel art.

ResizeImageMaskNode.name: ResizeImageMaskNode
ResizeImageMaskNode.description: Resize an image or mask using various scaling methods.

aspect_ratio.tooltip: The aspect ratio for the output dimensions.

megapixels.tooltip: Target total megapixels. 1.0 MP ≈ 1024x1024 for square.

multiple.tooltip: Nearest multiple of the result to set the selected resolution to.

preview.tooltip: Live preview of the calculated output resolution.

output_tooltips: Calculated width in pixels multiplied by the selected multiple.
Calculated height in pixels multiplied by the selected multiple.
ResolutionSelector.name: ResolutionSelector
ResolutionSelector.description: Calculate width and height from aspect ratio and megapixel target. Useful for setting up Empty Latent Image dimensions.

filename_prefix.tooltip: The prefix for the file to save. This may include formatting information such as %date:yyyy-MM-dd% or %Empty Latent Image.width% to include values from nodes.

format.tooltip: The output container. Auto uses MP4 for Auto/H.264 and WebM for AV1. MP4, MKV, and WebM select a specific container.

codec.tooltip: The output video codec. Auto preserves a compatible source stream. H.264 and AV1 re-encoding support SDR, HDR (HLG), and HDR PQ.

encoding.tooltip: Automatic preserves compatible H.264 streams. Re-encode applies custom encoding options.

crf.tooltip: Lower values produce higher quality and larger files.

encoding.tooltip: Automatic preserves compatible AV1 streams. Re-encode applies custom encoding options.

SaveVideo.name: SaveVideo
SaveVideo.description: Saves the input videos to your ComfyUI output directory.

video.tooltip: Video frames as image batch. Assumed to be 24 FPS; subsampled to 1 FPS internally.

thinking.tooltip: Operate in thinking mode if the model supports it.

use_default_template.tooltip: Use the built in system prompt/template if the model has one.

mtp.tooltip: Speculative decoding with the checkpoint's multi-token-prediction head. No effect without MTP weights. auto adapts the draft depth; 2-5 pins it. Sampled output stays correctly distributed but differs from non-MTP output for the same seed.

system_prompt.tooltip: Replaces the system prompt in the model's chat template. Ignored when the default template is not used.

temporal_size.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to decode at a time.

temporal_overlap.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to overlap.

ckpt_name.tooltip: The name of the checkpoint (model) to load.

CheckpointLoaderSimple.name: CheckpointLoaderSimple
CheckpointLoaderSimple.description: Loads a diffusion model checkpoint, diffusion models are used to denoise latents.
output_tooltips: The model used for denoising latents.
The CLIP model used for encoding text prompts.
The VAE model used for encoding and decoding images to and from latent space.

LTXAVTextEncoderLoader.name: LTXAVTextEncoderLoader
LTXAVTextEncoderLoader.description:
Recipes:
ltxav: gemma 3 12B or matching gemma 4 model

model.tooltip: The diffusion model the LoRA will be applied to.

clip.tooltip: The CLIP model the LoRA will be applied to.

strength_model.tooltip: How strongly to modify the diffusion model. This value can be negative.

strength_clip.tooltip: How strongly to modify the CLIP model. This value can be negative.

LoraLoader.name: LoraLoader
LoraLoader.description: This LoRA loader is used to modify both diffusion and CLIP models, altering the way in which latents are denoised such as applying styles. Multiple LoRA nodes can be linked together.

iclora_model.tooltip: Direct output from a LoRA Loader for the specific IC-LoRA from which to extract the metadata.

output_tooltips: IC-LoRA parameters extracted from the LoRA metadata (eg. reference_downscale_factor). Connect to LTXVAddGuide if the LoRA requires special handling of the guides.
GetICLoRAParameters.name: GetICLoRAParameters
GetICLoRAParameters.description: Extracts IC-LoRA parameters from the safetensors metadata of a LoRA-loaded model and outputs them for LTXVAddGuide (eg. reference_downscale_factor).

video.tooltip: The video to extract components from.

GetVideoComponents.name: GetVideoComponents
GetVideoComponents.description: Extracts video frames, audio, frame rate, bit depth, and color space.

model.tooltip: The model used for denoising the input latent.

seed.tooltip: The random seed used for creating the noise.

steps.tooltip: The number of steps used in the denoising process.

cfg.tooltip: The Classifier-Free Guidance scale balances creativity and adherence to the prompt. Higher values result in images more closely matching the prompt however too high values will negatively impact quality.

sampler_name.tooltip: The algorithm used when sampling, this can affect the quality, speed, and style of the generated output.

scheduler.tooltip: The scheduler controls how noise is gradually removed to form the image.

positive.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to include in the image.

negative.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to exclude from the image.

denoise.tooltip: The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling.

KSampler.name: KSampler
KSampler.description: Uses the provided model, positive and negative conditioning to denoise the latent image.

fov_x_degrees.tooltip: Horizontal field of view of the source camera. Sets the focal length used to unproject the depth map into 3D. 0 = auto-recover from the predicted points.

batch_size.tooltip: Images per inference call. Lower if you OOM on a long video / image set.

apply_mask.tooltip: Set masked-out (sky / invalid) pixels to inf in points and depth so meshing culls them. Disable to keep the raw predicted geometry everywhere; the mask is still returned separately.

refine_steps.tooltip: MoGe-3 only: sparse volumetric refinement passes over the predicted depth. More passes sharpen fine detail and edges at a roughly linear cost. 0 disables refinement. Ignored by MoGe-1 / MoGe-2.

MoGeInference.name: MoGeInference
MoGeInference.description: Run MoGe on a single image to estimate depth and geometry.

output.tooltip: DirectX vs OpenGL controls the normal-map green-channel convention. DirectX: green = -Y down (Unreal). OpenGL: green = +Y up (Blender, Substance, Unity, glTF).

MoGeRender.name: MoGeRender
MoGeRender.description: Render a depth map or normal map from geometry data

PreviewImage.name: PreviewImage
PreviewImage.description: Preview the images without saving them to the ComfyUI output directory.

duration.tooltip: Duration in seconds, or 0 for unlimited duration

strict_duration.tooltip: If True, when the specified duration is not possible, an error will be raised.
